item.title: When GPS lies at sea: How electronic warfare is threatening ships and their crews
item.description: GPS interference poses a growing threat to global shipping, especially in conflict zones. Spoofing attacks can mislead ships, causing disorientation and groundings. Crews often lack training to handle such cyber incidents, increasing risks as vessels become more connected.

item.title: How do women entrepreneurs survive in Ghana’s informal economy? We went to a local market to ask them
item.description: In Ghana's informal economy, women entrepreneurs are vital, managing micro-enterprises that sustain households. Despite challenges like lack of formal support, they thrive through risk diversification and social networks. Supporting them can enhance local markets and promote inclusive growth.

item.title: 16th Finance Commission pushes Panchayats towards greater fiscal autonomy and accountability
item.description: The 16th Finance Commission's recommendations aim to enhance Panchayats' fiscal autonomy and accountability through performance-linked grants and own-source revenue targets, while addressing capacity gaps in poorer regions.
